summary_en: Ferrotec raised its FY2026 dividend forecast to 300 yen per share from 200 yen, with year-end dividend increased to 200 yen from 100 yen, after earnings significantly exceeded May guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Ferrotec Corporation announced a revision of its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The company raised the per-share dividend from the previously forecasted 200 yen to 300 yen, with the year-end dividend specifically increased from 100 yen to 200 yen. The revision was prompted by operating results for the period significantly exceeding the earnings guidance disclosed on May 15, 2026. This brings the total annual dividend to 300 yen per share, comprising interim dividends of 100 yen and a revised year-end dividend of 200 yen.
